validationNotes: Actual nameKey9461→9464. Three complete new canonical names, five original/reprint pages and seven images reviewed. Jack printed E Soul/evolution symbol, Shellfo Sasage2/mana1, Creation full KingCell/composite rules confirmed. Old Creation HTML omits the combined back text/type; existing complete details unchanged and cross-checked against exact matching front plus hashed official later print full HTML/combined image. Added narrowly constrained KingCell evidence validation and positive/negative verifier tests; no arbitrary existing field overrides.

Jack Liger uses native E Soul base eligibility, printed E Soul,6000/W and paid4. Added optional self grave-hand continuation to existing tracked deck-to-grave arrival hook; original Arrogant1615 Zombie behavior unchanged. Actual BoneOdori self-mill accept/decline, hand discard exclusion, grave lock and Genmu ability ignore, sealed base, source physical UID and both players verified.

Shellfo g1743ManaStay narrows native origin restriction to opponent mana only; grave movement/own mana, ordinary hand summons, charging and mana tapping remain legal. Four actual native mana destination paths, hand recovery stop, mana summon/mana evolution prohibition, ignored source and Sasage2 paid Dispector/donor death verified.

Required new Creation reuses existing full NewWorldOrder face, GStrike and hand-mana untap. Exact official QA40946 frozen KingCell cast reproduced with Creation or Destruction in mana, both parts in mana,13 mana paid including the retained cell itself, preserved tap/zone serial, pending encrypted room restoration and physical conservation. New narrow spell component-origin tracking retains blocked mana components through combination/finish; ordinary King creature combinations unchanged and legacy saved casts still work. Deferred old Order KingFinish so component movement is handled once by normal spell finish; internal origins cleared on completion.

NewWorldOrder paid13 and actual Akashic3 free cast QA43953, full nonDragon bounce, optional grave Dragon deployment and haste/blocker until next own start pass. Expanded only Order deployment to real Dragon Aura/CrossGear/field through native enter; actual Endezaaku/GR host QA40945 confirms abilities given to Aura, not the attached GR creature. Actual Gods Trial exposes standalone cell cost0 QA40947; legal40 new decks preserve80 cards and schemas.

Related QA40160 exposed old WaterPick incorrectly suppressing its following bounce when mana retrieval was blocked. Fixed to reference the selected original cost independently of successful movement. Reproduced with real Bolshack Dragon mana cost6 and actual DondonMizumaku/Shellfo on both seats; the QA named final Glenmolt is unregistered but its unique abilities are irrelevant to this cost-reference rule and not claimed tested.

Original-print Dolhakaba promo is already registered under canonical dmr23-043 Greek Delta name. Official QA32408 and printed art confirm identity; do not count Katakana promo as a new card or modify existing definition. Promo import alias mapping not changed.

55 focused unique cases and affected short king/deck-grave/zone-policy/Sasage/evidence/online-save regressions pass, including six related legal CPU games in52.3sec; npm run check/audit/target/invariants pass. Old pending and interrupted full-suite status preserved; no push/publication/Netlify.
